css:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=DM+Serif+Display&display=swap">

.my-portal * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.my-portal {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  background: #f5f5f3;
  min-height: 500px;
  padding: 0 0 3rem;
}

.my-portal .topbar {
  background: #ffffff;
  border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
  padding: 0 2rem;
  height: 52px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.my-portal .topbar-logo {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #6c6b67;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.my-portal .avatar {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #1D9E75;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.my-portal .main {
  max-width: 960px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem 0;
}

.my-portal .page-title {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #1a1a18;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.my-portal .page-sub {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #6c6b67;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.my-portal .stats-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr auto;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.my-portal .stat-card {
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 1.4rem 1.6rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.my-portal .stat-card.green {
  background: #1D9E75;
}

.my-portal .stat-card.amber {
  background: #EF9F27;
}

.my-portal .stat-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
}

.my-portal .stat-number {
  font-size: 48px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #fff;
  line-height: 1;
}

.my-portal .add-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1.5px dashed rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 1.4rem 1.6rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 200px;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
}

.my-portal .add-card:hover {
  border-color: #1D9E75;
  background: #E1F5EE;
}

.my-portal .add-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #f0f0ee;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #888780;
  font-weight: 300;
}

.my-portal .add-label {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #6c6b67;
}

.my-portal .table-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 0.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.my-portal .table-header {
  padding: 0.9rem 1.5rem;
  border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.my-portal .table-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #6c6b67;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.my-portal .filter-pill {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 0.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  color: #6c6b67;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.my-portal table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.my-portal thead th {
  padding: 10px 1.5rem;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #888780;
  background: #f5f5f3;
  border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
}

.my-portal thead th:last-child { text-align: right; }

.my-portal tbody tr {
  border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  transition: background 0.1s;
}

.my-portal tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.my-portal tbody tr:hover { background: #f5f5f3; }

.my-portal tbody td {
  padding: 14px 1.5rem;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #1a1a18;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.my-portal tbody td:last-child { text-align: right; }

.my-portal .activity-name {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #1a1a18;
}

.my-portal .activity-id {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #888780;
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-family: monospace;
}

.my-portal .category-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #E1F5EE;
  color: #0F6E56;
}

.my-portal .status-dot {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #6c6b67;
}

.my-portal .dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #EF9F27;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.my-portal .dot.green { background: #1D9E75; }

.my-portal .manage-btn {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 0.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #1a1a18;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  position: relative;
}

.my-portal .manage-btn:hover { background: #f5f5f3; }

.my-portal .dropdown {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: calc(100% + 4px);
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 0.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  min-width: 140px;
  z-index: 10;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.my-portal .dropdown.open { display: block; }

.my-portal .dropdown a {
  display: block;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #1a1a18;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.my-portal .dropdown a:hover { background: #f5f5f3; }

.my-portal .footer {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 2.5rem;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #888780;
}
